verdict.rationale: Exa is API-first. Search, contents, answers, the Exa Agent/Connect and Websets (criteria, enrichments, webhook callbacks) are all documented as API/SDK capabilities. The docs frame the Websets Dashboard as an *alternative* way to build the same objects ('you can also build websets visually… no code required'), which implies the UI is a layer over the API rather than a superset. The community report of a wrong 'Get Code' cURL snippet is a snippet bug, not evidence of a UI-only capability. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that account/key/billing/team management is available via API, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
